Li Xia was reborn. At that time, she was taking her two children to the city to find her husband, but her husband was determined to divorce her. This time she stopped pestering him and calmly accepted the proposal.

In her previous life, she worked hard to raise two children, while the man didn’t even care about them for a day. When they grew up, the father and son recognized each other in college. Since the blood relationship cannot be broken, you should raise him since childhood, and don’t tire her to death. The man thought about it for a long time and agreed to her request.
The two divorced peacefully, she took her daughter and he took his son. She wanted to stay in the city to make money but had no place to stay. After coming out of his alley, she hugged her daughter and curled up in the corner. An old lady came out from inside and looked at her for a long time before speaking.

95557.synopsis:
The doomed mercenary Kinain, having lost everything due to his brother’s scheme and despairing over the death of his lover, spirals out of control. 
While searching for a way to restore the city turned to stone due to his rampage, he heads to the dragon’s palace, enticed by the promise that becoming a dragon’s mate can grant him anything he desires. However, 
“You’re quite unlucky, human. You could have died without pain right now.”
The dragon he meets harbors nothing but hatred for humans and plans to torment him in any way possible…
Even stranger is that Kinain, upon seeing the dragon, is reminded of his deceased lover. Despite having no resemblance in appearance or personality, the dragon’s eyes, identical to those of his lover, play a cruel trick of fate.
*
“Don’t mistake spending my rut with you as an invitation to be my mate. You’re merely a plaything to pass the time.”
“I know that. So I hope you’ll soon find a proper mate.”
The dragon finding a good mate and becoming happy was all Kinain wished for in the little time he had left.
“…You want me to find a mate quickly, huh?”
Why did it feel like the dragon’s mu*derous intent had grown even thicker?
“Then you…”
“Ugh, wait!”
“Are you going out to seduce another alpha?”
The dragon gripped Kinain’s wrist tightly, as if to break it, and whispered in a low, gloomy voice.
“No. You can’t do that. Even if I find a mate, you’ll still have to remain here.”

96581.synopsis:
Xia Jing runs a safe house in the horror world.
While others are escaping in the dungeon, he is planting flowers in the safe house.
While others were killing monsters in the dungeon, he was cooking delicious food in the safe house.
What if someone breaks in?
By paying for any item such as the faceless woman’s teeth, the sea monster’s hair, or the incubus’ tongue, you can rest in the safe house for a night.
Don’t worry, monsters don’t dare to come close here. In addition to a comfortable double bed room, you will also enjoy delicious food, elegant music, and a small supermarket that comes with the safe house.
In the small supermarket, there are all the props that may help you pass the level.
Every Monday, the safe house is closed because the store manager needs to go out to collect supplies——
In a certain dungeon, the players behind him were all running away. Xia Jing kicked open the door of the house where the monsters were hiding, holding a pair of scissors in his left hand and a hemp rope in his right hand. He said with a smile: “Wow, we will have a good harvest today.”
He held up the scissors and hemp rope and said gently: “Don’t be afraid, it will be fine soon.”
The ferocious faces of the monsters that were ready to scare the players were frozen there.
Then one by one screamed: “Ahhhhhhhhhhhhhh.”
*
One day, when Xia Jing went out to catch a copy (actually to collect supplies), he picked up the human boss who ranked first in points in the entire horror world.
The boss fainted and fell to the ground, suspected to have been attacked, and his life was short-lived.
Xia Jing knelt down and groped the big man’s body with his hands… intending to see if there was anything he could pick up——
As a result, the boss suddenly woke up, grabbed his wrist, and said with a half-smile: “What are you doing?”
Xia Jing: “…”
Xia Jing took a deep breath, knocked out the boss with one punch, then calmly carried the treasure and left, sighing inwardly that it was a bit scary.
Later, Xia Jing found out that he was wanted by the boss in the entire horror world:)

99653.synopsis:
Transmigrating into a book, Ye Linglong became the malicious cannon-fodder female supporting character in a cultivation novel. Her aptitude was terrible, and she even forced the female protagonist to take her into the top sect during a cultivation tournament. After joining, she kept opposing the female protagonist, only to meet a tragic end.
To happily survive, Ye Linglong immediately gave up on threatening the female protagonist and turned her back on the prestigious sect. She joined the worst sect in the cultivation world instead. Being a malicious supporting character? Not for her! She just wanted to live beautifully on her own.
She thought joining the worst sect would let her laze around, eat, drink, and play like a salted fish. But who would’ve guessed that everyone in this “worst” sect was a borderline-insane villain, constantly on the edge of corruption, ready to sacrifice themselves one by one to the female protagonist?
Wait… Is their sect about to be wiped out? Don’t panic, she’s got this.
First Senior Brother: Seeks revenge after his entire clan is massacred, rampages through the cultivation world, but is eventually defeated by the female protagonist?
Junior Sister: “Senior Brother, I know her cultivation, techniques, and all her treasures. Come on, let’s power up! We can’t lose!”
Second Senior Brother: Hides his demon bloodline but is discovered and hunted by everyone?
Junior Sister: “Why are you hiding? With your badass bloodline, you could dominate both realms! I even know where the interdimensional portal is—go conquer them!”
Third Senior Brother: Becomes a demon after his golden core shatters and his meridians are ruined, eventually becoming a major boss defeated by a coalition?
Junior Sister: “I know a place where you can rebuild your golden core and repair your meridians. Hold on, we’ve got this team fight in the bag!”
Fourth Senior Brother: Falls in unrequited love with the female protagonist, gets heartbroken, and turns dark, only to be killed by the male lead?
Junior Sister: “This won’t work! Look, Simp No. 1 gives her treasures, Simp No. 2 signs contracts… You, Simp No. N, might as well just sacrifice yourself!”
The entire sect looked at their teary-eyed, seemingly weak, yet trouble-stirring, nonsensical junior sister: Was this joker sent by the monkeys to mess with us?

99909.synopsis:
A World Obsessed with Card Games Gets Its “Protagonist” Back! (Not Really)
In worlds where card games dominate everything, it’s almost a cliché for the fate of the world to hang on the outcome of a card battle.
I, Mitsuru Tanefuda, found myself reincarnated into such a world. Thankfully, my dream came true—I became the manager of my very own card shop.
In this world, people duel with cards, filled with joy and excitement, and I wanted to watch it all up close.
But for some reason, everyone seems to think I’m some legendary hero who solved massive crises in the past, watching over the next generation like a noble predecessor.
The truth is, I’ve never resolved any world-shaking incidents—not even once.
This is the story of a reincarnated man who became the manager of a card shop in a world where card games take precedence over everything else. Despite having no great achievements to his name, everyone around him assumes he must have been a hero who once saved the world.

100677.synopsis:
Flirtatious, cunning, and playful Alpha prisoner x outwardly cold but inwardly soft Omega prosecutor
Years later, the first time Eugene met Prosecutor Luo Hai was in the courtroom where he was sentenced to death.
The man, cold and unfeeling, read out the charges, snuffing out any spark of rebellion in its cradle.
Some cheered, others lamented, while Eugene remained expressionless, as if none of it concerned him.
The second time was in the pitch-black confines of the prison.
The prosecutor’s suit was immaculate, out of place amidst the grim surroundings. His dark eyes locked onto Eugene as he ordered the guards to remove his shackles.
“I need him.”
The third time was in a dimly lit, ambiguous bedroom.
Eugene pinned Luo Hai’s wrists, leaning close to whisper by his ear, “The noble prosecutor, symbol of Alpha authority and order, turns out to be an Omega who can’t even control himself during his heat. Tell me, what would those Alphas who worship you think if they found out?”
…
Fragile things are often made of the hardest materials.
Because his heart was hard, when it fell to the ground, it shattered into pieces.
……
No Trigger Warnings: None provided. Please assume this story contains all potential triggers if you are concerned.

100933.synopsis:
The Leopold Team, composed of A-rank Espers from Sector 4, was led by Baek Eu-jin, an 11-year veteran healer-type Esper.
That is until an accident involving his team’s Guide changed everything.
An unprecedented event occurred: both an A-rank Esper and an A-rank Guide lost their abilities. The shocking incident sent Sector 4 into chaos, but Baek Eu-jin secretly celebrated, looking forward to a peaceful retirement.
But then…
“Choi Ran’s ability came back! And it’s a healing power! The same type as yours, Captain!”
Baek Eu-jin, who had been dreaming of a carefree, unemployed life, suddenly finds himself reawakening—not as an Esper, but as a Guide. To make things stranger, his and the Guide’s abilities seem to have switched.
Although disheartened at first, Eu-jin quickly adjusts to the comforts of a desk job as a Guide—one far easier than his days as an Esper.
He might have even been able to enjoy this peaceful office life, if not for Kwon Su-ho.
* * *
“Do you really like desk jobs that much?”
“Between the steady paycheck, safe work environment, and fixed hours, I’d say there’s no comparison.”
“… Fair enough.”
The man, surprisingly, agreed without much resistance. His quick acceptance made Eu-jin uneasy, and that unease was validated when Kwon Su-ho added something unexpected.
“In that case, I just need to make your job harder.”
“What?”
Rising from his seat, Su-ho tousled his hair messily, pressing his knuckles hard against his lips. His flesh turned red and swelled slightly under the pressure.
Satisfied, Su-ho ran his thumb over his reddened lips, then tugged at the black turtleneck he wore, as if regretting his choice of attire.
“I shouldn’t have worn this. If I’d gone with a shirt, I could’ve ripped a few buttons off.”
“What are you doing?”
“Getting ready to make things difficult for you, Baek Eu-jin.”
Su-ho’s deliberately disheveled appearance gave off the impression of a man who had just been through a heated make-out session.
With clear intent, he took long strides toward the Guiding Room door, leaving Eu-jin no time to stop him.
“Wait, no! Stop!”
Despite Eu-jin’s desperate plea, the doorknob turned, and the door swung open. The noise from outside flooded in as Su-ho stepped out and looked back at Eu-jin with a sly smile.
“I really enjoyed today, Guide.”
With an unmistakably suggestive glance, Su-ho shut the door behind him.
The Guiding Room fell silent once more. Eu-jin, stunned, muttered under his breath.
“That crazy bastard.”
Just as Eu-jin feared, the rumor spread like wildfire.

101957.synopsis:
Wu Heng, the most powerful shaman doctor of ancient times, woke up to find himself transmigrated into a novel, becoming the grandson of a traditional Chinese medicine practitioner. Remembering how his steward father, obsessed with gossip in the wealthy circles, was callously discarded by a domineering CEO and died impoverished, Wu Heng decided to start a live stream to earn a fortune for his dear old dad!
A new live stream channel called “Chengde Medical Clinic” appeared on the Shark platform. Although the streamer claimed to have centuries of medical experience and loved to brag, his exceptional good looks attracted a number of fans obsessed with his appearance.
Until——
① A wealthy madam, who had sought medical treatment everywhere to no avail, came to the live stream with her pot-bellied son.
Wu Heng diagnosed remotely: “Pregnant. Pregnant with lots of snake babies.”
In a blink of an eye, Wu Heng performed a shamanic dance, and the young man immediately retched, vomiting countless live little snakes.
Wealthy Madam & Netizens: What the f*ck??!!
② A 20-year-old campus heartthrob, a landlubber his whole life, suddenly sprouted fish scales all over his body overnight, mastering butterfly, backstroke, and breaststroke without any training, determined to dominate the Olympics and win glory for the country.
Wu Heng connected online for a diagnosis: “If you let this condition develop further, you’ll turn into a mermaid.”
The campus heartthrob was thrilled that he was about to become a mermaid prince from a fairytale, with fans all over the world.
Wu Heng curiously asked: “A mermaid with a fish head and a human body is acceptable too?”
The campus heartthrob froze: Wait, what kind of head??
③ A genius of Chinese painting, blind for many years, held onto the last sliver of hope and asked: “Is there any chance for me to regain my sight?”
Wu Heng shook his head frankly: “Your eyes are completely dead.”
The genius painter despaired, but the next moment Wu Heng directly seized the malicious ghost that caused his blindness and performed a live organ transplant.
The painting genius, not only regaining his sight but also gaining yin-yang eyes: “…!”
Netizens: …God, a divine doctor!
Later, patients who frequently lost their heads would sneak in at night, carrying seven or eight heads, begging Wu Heng to pick the prettiest one and sew it back on.
A female teacher, dead for three years, dragged her already decayed and stinking body, inquiring about Wu Heng’s method of lighting a sky lantern to extend her life.
Countless patients suffering from strange illnesses came from all directions, making the live stream incredibly popular.
****
In recent years, China has been experiencing a spiritual invasion, with a proliferation of demons and ghosts, and countless people inexplicably suffering from all sorts of bizarre illnesses.
Just when everyone was at their wit’s end, Wu Heng, who could cure diseases, tell fortunes, draw talismans, catch ghosts, and even perform shamanic dances, entered their field of vision.
The number of viewers in the live stream continued to grow, with netizens constantly switching between “Holy crap, a shaman doctor who communicates with the heavens and the underworld is just awesome” and “Wife is so cool and strong, let me kiss you to death,” and they even spontaneously formed a Wu Heng Protection Alliance.
Until one day, netizens saw Wu Heng nestled in the arms of a cold young man full of evil aura, his face flushed with drunkenness.
The young man’s icy lips lightly nibbled on the white flesh of his nape, asking when Wu Heng would finally stop seeing patients and accompany him. As the young man’s expression grew increasingly gloomy, the surrounding resentment soared to the heavens.
Wu Heng gritted his teeth: “Stop emitting resentment and creating new patients for me!”
Wu Heng imitated the method the young man had diligently taught him last night, planting a kiss on the young man’s lips.
In an instant, the yin energy around the young man disappeared completely, and his smiling lips let out a satisfied sigh.

102213.synopsis:
Third-rate writer Zhou Huaihuai collapsed in front of her computer after working tirelessly on updates. When she woke up, she found herself on a film set.
Zhou Huaihuai: I’m not acting.
Agent: Fine, no acting, then pay the penalty fee!
Zhou “Broke” Huaihuai: Why don’t I give it a try?
Months later, the drama aired on a platform, and the leader of her haters angrily scolded: Zhou Huaihuai, did a dog eat your remaining shred of acting skills?
Zhou Huaihuai: If you think you’re so great, why don’t you try!
Hater Leader: Fine, I’ll do it!
This is a melodramatic story of a third-rate writer accidentally stepping into the entertainment industry, and it’s also an inspiring tale of turning her biggest hater into her wife. Hope everyone enjoys it.

103493.synopsis:
I transmigrated into a character in a fantasy novel that my terrible professor made me read.
But instead of becoming the capable protagonist or the cool supporting character… What? An extra character?
Actually, this might be better.
I’ll leave saving the world to the protagonist, and I’ll do what I’ve always wanted—research magical creatures.
Under Professor Diabel Asrein, who’s called the greatest genius in this world—my second round of graduate school life begins.

104773.synopsis:
My favorite RPG game has become reality.
Since things have turned out this way, I might as well do all the things I’ve wanted to do.

105797.synopsis:
Jiang Ran died unexpectedly, and her soul was bound to a system. In order to reshape her body, she needed to save the beautiful, strong and miserable male protagonist in the world of female supremacy.
In the first world, when she traveled through, she was marrying someone. At that time, the man had a red veil on his head, and you could see his dragon and phoenix figure in the shadows.
On the wedding night, the red veil fell off, and the man was handsome and not like an ordinary person, with a gentle expression. Who could imagine that he was a black-bellied villain who killed so many people that only his name was left.
In the second world, the male protagonist was pure and lovely, and his beauty was always coveted by others, but he was deceived by the original female protagonist and sold, and was played with and insulted. In the end, he couldn’t stand it and jumped into the river and died. When she traveled through, the original female protagonist was sending him to sell himself!
In the third world, a simple and kind little mute man from a wealthy family, with a handsome face and eyes as pure as crystal, should have a happy life, but the original female protagonist fell in love with the dowry and used a trick to cheat marriage. When she traveled through, the original female protagonist was greedily looking at the dowry.
After reading the plot, Jiang Ran said: “Too bad, too bad!”
What she has to do is to turn into a spring breeze to send warmth and save all the beautiful, strong, miserable and pitiful people!

Midnight Wax Museum

[Rule 2: You are the only person in the museum. If you hear someone call your name, ignore it and quickly move away.] 
[Rule 3: Patrol the museum every two hours. When passing wax figures, avoid making eye contact.] 
[Rule 4: Wax figures do not move. If their positions differ from the reference photos, return to the security room immediately.] 
…

109637.synopsis:
The kingdom’s top academy, open only to nobles, had never been a welcoming place for someone like me—a broke noble barely scraping by.
It was a gathering spot for highborn sons and daughters.
The unspoken rule was that students were there to find marriage partners who had the right face and status.
So someone like me, who actually came to study, always felt out of place.
Still, I kept attending the academy—for one simple reason: money.
Graduating from the most prestigious school in the kingdom would boost my reputation, helping me land a better job.
All to support my family… and more importantly, to keep my little sister from being forced into a marriage she didn’t want.
No matter how tough things got, I had no choice but to keep going.
But even with all that determination, there were times I just wanted to be alone.
One day, while wandering the vast academy grounds in search of peace and quiet, I stumbled into a rose garden.
That’s where I met her—
A beautiful girl with silver hair and blue eyes. And then, completely out of the blue, she made me an unexpected offer:
“In that case… how about we enter into a fake engagement?”
I agreed, thinking it would be a mutually beneficial arrangement.
Only later did I learn that she was Yuliana Arrose, the one and only daughter of a duke in the entire academy.
And for some reason… she started enjoying this fake relationship a little too much.
“Fufu. Since you’re my fiancé now, you can be more affectionate with me, you know?”
Wait… this is still a fake engagement… right?
associated_names: 貧乏貴族の俺が貴族学園随一の麗しき公爵令嬢と偽装婚約したら、なぜか溺愛してくるようになった。

110405.synopsis:
At the first thunderclap of Jingzhe (Awakening of Insects), Chu Xia unexpectedly learns that she is a lovestruck supporting female character in a male-centered period novel, doomed to spend her entire life sacrificing for the male lead.
When he needs love, she gives up life-changing opportunities for the woman he loves.
When he needs a family, she marries him, offering her dowry and support.
When he needs a career, she sells her family’s courtyard house and small restaurant, investing everything to help him start a business.
When he becomes successful, she not only takes care of his parents at home, she also raises the illegitimate child that the female lead brings to him.

If someone wants to play this tragic character, be her guest—but she’s not doing it!
What, does having money mean she doesn’t know how to spend it? Does owning assets mean she doesn’t know how to profit from them?
Breaking free from the male and female leads, she refuses to be a pitiful sacrifice.
Armed with her courtyard home, she opens a restaurant and cooks delicious meals.
From beauty to wealth, she stages a full-spectrum comeback.

116805.synopsis:
The game world “Hongyuan Continent” had just gone live in the real world when an unknown error forcibly logged out all players.
But Shen Yan suddenly realized that his body hadn’t fully returned—his right hand had been left behind in Hongyuan Continent. What’s more, his game interface hadn’t shut down. He was still getting system prompts for killing monsters and receiving loot. Thanks to this, his strength kept increasing.
As it turns out, someone picked up his right hand—and was using it to grind monsters!

Unfortunately, I lost my cultivation—and my right arm. Stranded in a foreign land, I happened to come across a severed right arm. To my surprise, it was completely compatible with my body, so I temporarily used it as a prosthetic.

118341.synopsis:
Xu Yan accidentally went viral online because of a faceless cross-dressing photo. With his soft, flexible waist, long fair legs, and a unique blend of innocence and allure, he quickly rose to fame as the latest “goddess” on a certain app.
Private messages came pouring in daily from thirsty admirers, and tipping to “urge uploads” grew more frequent. Xu Yan secretly bought some cute dresses online and only dared to wear them and snap photos when his roommates weren’t around.
But one day, a strange fan appeared.
He never messaged, only tipped — and very quickly became the top-ranked supporter on the leaderboard.
As per usual, Xu Yan would give the top supporter some private “fan benefits” like chatting or playing games together.
So, he took the initiative to message the silent #1 fan:
[Yanyan] : Gege, you’re #1 again~ You can ask for any reward you like!
A long silence passed before the cool and aloof fan finally replied:
[year] : Can you do it?
[Yanyan] : ……
 Wuwu… that kind of thing is off-limits!
***
Wen Sinian, a cold and quiet computer science major — rich, tall, smart, handsome, and built like a god.
Countless men and women had tried and failed to win over this flower.
As Wen Sinian’s roommate, Xu Yan had always kept a polite, distant, and friendly relationship — ever since day one, he knew this man was serious and stoic.
What he didn’t know… was that Wen Sinian had a severe leg fetish.
He had a thing for long, fair, straight legs — especially if they had some softness to them. Bonus points if the joints were a rosy pink that would flush into a decadent, glistening red after just a bit of rough handling.
One day, a push notification from a randomly installed app caught Wen Sinian’s attention.
It was a faceless photo of someone cross-dressing — and the legs in the picture made his breath catch.
He’d never seen a pair of legs so perfectly suited to his tastes. Even more damning — there was a tiny red mole on the inner thigh that nearly drove him wild.
He scrolled through the blogger’s past posts:
Black lace-trimmed miniskirt
Bold, high-slit rose qipao
White tight-fitting pencil skirt
Sweet Lolita-style ribbons and lace stockings
…
The more he looked, the deeper the desire in his cold, restrained eyes grew.
Then one day, purely by accident, Wen caught sight of a white ribbon sticking out from his cute roommate’s bed…
***
Later, Xu Yan decided to stop dressing up in secret. He logged out of that account for good.
But just as he was about to quietly throw away all his little dresses, he bumped straight into a tall figure. The dresses scattered everywhere.
Xu Yan blushed furiously, his eyes shimmering with tears. He was at a complete loss for how to explain.
But Wen Sinian only crouched down, calmly gathered the clothes, folded them one by one in front of him, and put them back where they belonged.
“Keep them,” he said, wrapping his arms around his stunned, soft-waisted roommate and gently wiping the tears from his eyes.
 “You’ll still need them.”
Xu Yan didn’t understand at the time — but he’d soon find out exactly what Wen meant by “needing them.”
He moved out of the dorms and into Wen Sinian’s private home off-campus.
And from then on, he never had to buy his own dresses again.
The #1 top fan had already prepared a whole walk-in closet full of them just for him…
…and helped him put them on, night after night.

120389.synopsis:
With the death of his mother, a woman who lived and died as a “mistress,” young Yukishiro Haruka is cast into the lion’s den: the home of the formidable Fujiwara clan. His father, the man who married into this powerful family, is long dead, leaving Haruka utterly alone and besieged on all sides.

His cruel half-sister wants to control him like a new toy. In a house where even the maids dare to mock him, Haruka’s only weapon is a natural, magnetic charm he doesn’t yet understand. He must learn to tread carefully, or he will be consumed by the very people who claim to be his family.

122181.synopsis:
“A romance between a mute defect and a s*ave-born lowly creature? Could there be a more ridiculous scene than this?”

The moment Ye Qiyan opened his eyes, he found himself in the world of Train Survival.
Everyone must disembark at each station to explore in order to survive.
The lucky ones discover treasures; the unlucky ones lose their lives.
Opportunity and danger walk hand in hand.
Gather supplies, upgrade your train, and build your very own personalized train world.

Anything in his hands could be evolved to its utmost potential!
【Crude Dagger → Enchanted Sharp Dagger → Eternal Cutter】
【White Forest Fruit Tree → Blessed Fruit Tree → Venus’ Golden Fruit Tree】

【Ascension Successful! Record Broken! Destiny Divergence Module Unlocked!】

Lin Yun transmigrated to the Heavenly Mystic Continent and started off with an orphanage. By raising orphans, he could earn rewards!
Originally, Lin Yun only wanted to live a laid-back life. But years later, he realized that he had raised a group of peerless empresses!
The strongest Empress of the Sword Dao!
The strongest Empress of the Devil Dao!
The strongest Empress of the Demon Race!
…It could be said that Lin Yun reigned over the Heavenly Mystic Continent. Whoever saw him, even the mightiest, would have to offer him a cigarette!
